_comment: Difficulty curves (calibrated with tests/balance_sim.tscn -- career). xp: XP needed to go from level L to L+1 = base + per_level x (L-1) + per_level_sq x (L-1)^2 (LevelSystem). enemy_floor_mult: enemy stat multiplier for floors 1..25, on top of their level (floor + 1); beyond the table the last step repeats (EnemyFactory.get_base_multiplier).
